packs.title: Core PromptDrive
packs.description: Production-safe templates for solo-dev planning, implementation, review, and JPE explanation.

templates.title: JPE Explainer
templates.description: Explain a technical idea in Just Plain English with concrete action steps.
templates.template: Explain {{topic}} to a {{audience}} in Just Plain English. Avoid jargon, define any unavoidable technical terms, and end with {{format}}.

templates.title: Sprint Slice Planner
templates.description: Convert a feature into a narrow implementation slice with acceptance checks.

slots.label: Constraints
slots.default: solo developer, no new dependencies, keep blast radius small

slots.label: Verification
slots.default: unit tests, build, focused UI smoke test

templates.template:
Create a vertical sprint slice for {{feature}}.

Constraints:
{{constraints}}

Return: scope, data flow, files to touch, risks, and verification plan. Verification must include {{checks}}.

templates.title: Security Review
templates.description: Review a design or diff for practical security issues.

slots.label: Sensitive Data
slots.default: API keys, local files, prompt history, memory records

templates.template:
Review this NEURODECK surface for security issues: {{surface}}.

Sensitive data involved: {{data}}.

Lead with concrete findings. For each finding include severity, exploit path in plain English, and the smallest safe fix.

templates.title: Code Review
templates.description: Find correctness, regression, and test risks in a code change.
